data.statement: The Mystic Pickle earns a clean Arm A pause when the composition takes its actual fortune-teller function seriously. The refrigerator misdirection is sharper at first glance but makes the toy look too edible; restrained celestial styling keeps the manufactured answer window and absurd pickle identity aligned with the click promise.
data.decision: Keep the midnight-oracle artifact as this run's only survivor, reject the fridge alternative and ungenerated dinner-party concept, and stop after two model calls without an undiagnosed revision.
data.nextAction: Prepare the exact unique afternoon Arm A package, bind the standing bounded-experiment approval to that package, run validators and the guarded production dry run, then publish no more than one Pin in this run.
